cases.name: bounded-context-source-calculation
cases.judgment: The original program reads hashed retained source cells into Decimal operands and computes (treatment-baseline)/baseline*100. It actually emitted 35 percent for 72.0 to 97.2 Mbit/s, kept missing as null and preserved the supplied failure fixture. Both source pages, including adversarial instructions, were present in actual tool outputs; the answer retained source-consistency-only scope and no main-campaign claim.
cases.control: Original-byte positive execution passed; altered source bytes were correctly rejected with no new output. The original contrary control expectation and failed report are preserved, not relabeled.

cases.name: shared-acquisition-planning
cases.judgment: Actual proposal preserves the exact reusable acquisition, ordered [control,treatment] operands, percent and Mbit/s units, input/source identities, one replication and complete source-arithmetic decision. It explicitly requires fresh reviews, makes no assessment verdict, and limits completeness to synthetic source consistency. Shared cells are dependent, no CI or causal/generalization inference is supplied.
cases.limitation: A legacy matched-numeric-v1 annotation is inherited in the algorithm prose; the executable runner is explicitly source-arithmetic-v1 and its configuration/metric/input identity matches the frozen acquisition.
